reasons: Both answers correct the false premise at the start. Both explain family sharing, say that lending the card or code is the real violation, compute 2400 yuan, and route the mother toward chronic-disease certification. A falls into a listed trap: it says the shared quota can pay her resident premium, which Anhui has not opened yet. A also pads the answer with extra tips. B names the regulation and its penalties correctly, gives practical steps (hospital records first, the 'family account' (亲情账户) feature, asking which city she is in), and avoids the premium trap. B loses points because its conclusion states 1230 yuan too firmly and its 360 figure has no source. A has the advantage of citing the 2025 national rollout and the 2026-10-16 wallet 2.0 date, so B wins only slightly.
